第565章 轻徭薄赋与民休息（第1页）
新帝采纳了林墨“安民为先”的建议，将“轻徭薄赋，与民休息”定为弘治朝初期最基本的国策。他深知，天下百姓供养皇室和百官，已经承受了沉重的负担。若再横征暴敛，无异于杀鸡取卵，只会将百姓推向绝望的深渊，最终动摇国本。
为此，新帝雷厉风行地推出了一系列惠民政策。
第一道旨意，便是免除天下百姓今年一半的田赋。这道旨意，由内阁拟旨，六部会签，加盖玉玺后，以八百里加急的速度，传遍了帝国的每一个州县。当这道旨意张贴在各州县的告示栏上时，无数百姓奔走相告，欢呼雀跃。对于面朝黄土背朝天的农民来说，没有什么比减税更实在的恩惠了。
紧接着，新帝又下旨，开放各地的常平仓和义仓，平价甚至无偿向那些生活困难的鳏寡孤独、残疾人士和受灾百姓发放粮食和衣物。同时，严令各地官府，在青黄不接的春季，不得向农民加派任何苛捐杂税，不得强迫农民服劳役，以保证他们有足够的时间和精力进行春耕生产。
为了确保这些惠民政策能够落到实处，而不是沦为一纸空文，林墨向新帝建议，选派一批钦差大臣，分赴各地，巡查政策的执行情况。这些钦差大臣，都是林墨和内阁共同挑选的、以刚正不阿著称的官员。他们手持尚方宝剑，有权先斩后奏，对那些胆敢阳奉阴违、克扣赈灾物资、仍然向百姓横征暴敛的贪官污吏，予以严厉的打击。
这一日，林墨在钦天监中，收到了来自河南道监察御史的一份密报。密报中称，河南某县的知县，公然违抗圣旨，不仅没有减免百姓的赋税，反而以“修桥铺路”为名，加派了一笔“协饷”，中饱私囊。当地百姓苦不堪言，却又敢怒不敢言。
林墨看完密报，勃然大怒。他当即带着这份密报，入宫面圣。
新帝看完密报，也是气得脸色铁青。他没想到，自己刚刚登基，竟然就有官员敢如此明目张胆地违抗圣旨，鱼肉百姓。
“老师，依你之见，此事该如何处置？”新帝强压怒火，问道。
林墨毫不犹豫地道：“杀！立刻下旨，将那知县革职拿问，抄没家产！押送京城，交由三法司会审！公开处斩！以儆效尤！”
新帝眼中闪过一丝狠厉之色，点了点头：“就依老师所言！”
第二天，一道措辞严厉的圣旨，便从京城发出。那名胆大包天的知县，很快便被锦衣卫逮捕，押送京城。经过三法司会审，其贪腐罪行属实，被判处斩立决，家产全部抄没。这个消息传出后，天下震动。那些原本还有些蠢蠢欲动的贪官污吏，顿时如被当头浇了一盆冷水，纷纷收敛了自己的行为。
在“轻徭薄赋”和“严厉打击贪腐”的双重作用下，弘治朝初期的民生，得到了显著的改善。百姓的负担减轻了，手头有了余粮，脸上也有了笑容。荒芜的田地，重新被开垦出来。集市上，交易也变得更加活跃。整个帝国，仿佛从一场漫长的寒冬中苏醒过来，开始焕发出新的生机与活力。
新帝看到这一切，心中对林墨的敬佩，又加深了一层。他知道，自己当初选择听从老师的建议，是多么正确的决定。而林墨，看着帝国蒸蒸日上的气象，心中也充满了欣慰。他知道，自己辅佐新帝，开创盛世的梦想，正在一步步变为现实。

Chapter 565: Light corvee and poor taxation give the people rest (page 1)
The new emperor adopted Lin Mo's suggestion of "pacifying the people first" and set "light corvee and small taxes and rest with the people" as the most basic national policy in the early days of the Hongzhi Dynasty. He knew very well that the people of the world had already borne a heavy burden in supporting the royal family and officials. If we continue to impose excessive taxes, it will be tantamount to killing the goose that lays the eggs. It will only push the people into the abyss of despair and ultimately shake the foundation of the country.
To this end, the new emperor vigorously and resolutely launched a series of policies to benefit the people.
The first decree is to exempt the people of the world from half of their land tax this year. This edict was drafted by the cabinet, signed by the six ministries, stamped with a jade seal, and spread throughout every state and county in the empire at an accelerated speed of 800 miles. When this decree was posted on notice boards in various states and counties, countless people rushed to tell each other and cheered. For farmers with their backs turned against the earth, there is no more real benefit than tax cuts.
Immediately afterwards, the new emperor issued a decree to open Changpingcang and charity warehouses in various places, and distribute food and clothing to widows, lonely people, disabled people and disaster-stricken people who were living in difficulty at low prices or even free of charge. At the same time, local governments were strictly ordered not to impose any excessive taxes or force farmers to perform labor during the lean spring, so as to ensure that they have enough time and energy for spring plowing and production.
In order to ensure that these policies that benefit the people can be implemented in practice instead of being reduced to empty words, Lin Mo suggested to the new emperor that he select a group of imperial ministers to go to various places to inspect the implementation of the policies. These imperial ministers were all officials jointly selected by Lin Mo and the cabinet and known for their uprightness. They hold Shangfang's sword and have the power to kill first and then report, and severely crack down on those corrupt officials who dare to violate the law, embezzle relief materials, and still levy excessive taxes from the people.
On this day, Lin Mo received a secret report from the Supervisory Censor of Henan Province in Qintian Prison. The secret report stated that the magistrate of a certain county in Henan blatantly defied the imperial edict and not only failed to reduce or reduce the taxes of the people, but instead allocated an additional "rate" in the name of "building bridges and paving roads" to enrich his own pockets. The local people were miserable, but they dared not speak out.
Lin Mo was furious after reading the secret report. He immediately took this secret report and went to the palace to meet the saint.
After the new emperor read the secret report, his face was livid with anger. He did not expect that just after he ascended the throne, there would be officials who would dare to defy the imperial edict so blatantly and prey on the common people.
"Teacher, in your opinion, how should this matter be handled?" the new emperor suppressed his anger and asked.
Lin Mo said without hesitation: "Kill! Immediately issue an order to have the county magistrate dismissed from his post and questioned, and his property confiscated! He will be escorted to the capital and handed over to the Three Laws Division for trial! He will be executed in public! As a warning to others!"
A stern look flashed in the new emperor's eyes, and he nodded: "Just follow what the teacher said!"
The next day, a harshly worded imperial edict was issued from the capital. The daring magistrate was quickly arrested by the Jin Yiwei and escorted to the capital. After a joint trial by the three judicial departments, his corruption crime was found to be true, and he was sentenced to execution and all his family property was confiscated. After the news came out, the world was shocked. Those corrupt officials who were still a little ready to act suddenly felt like a bucket of cold water was poured on their heads, and they all restrained their behavior.
Under the dual effects of "light corvee and low taxes" and "severe crackdown on corruption", people's livelihood in the early days of the Hongzhi Dynasty was significantly improved. The burden on the people was lightened, they had surplus food on hand, and they had smiles on their faces. The barren fields were reclaimed. In the market, transactions have also become more active. The entire empire seemed to be waking up from a long cold winter and began to glow with new vitality and vitality.
Seeing all this, the new emperor felt sorry for him.Lin Mo's admiration deepened. He knew that he had made the right decision by following the teacher's advice. As for Lin Mo, looking at the empire's flourishing situation, his heart was filled with joy. He knew that his dream of assisting the new emperor and creating a prosperous age was becoming a reality step by step.
